description: This file defines several common UI components for a React project, including a Card component, Button component, Input component, and StatusBanner component, along with some color constants used across these components.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a stylized card container with optional title, subtitle, footer, and children content.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a stylized button with support for variants ('primary', 'secondary', 'ghost') and loading state.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A React functional component rendering a styled input field with optional label and error message.

methods.name: StatusBanner
methods.description: A React functional component displaying a status message with type ('success', 'error', 'info'), title, optional message, and optional close button.
